sentences: Dynamic complexity maintains query answers as a database changes through a sequence of updates.
The source asks whether its ParityExists query can be maintained using first-order update rules.
The challenge is to track a parity-related global property through local logical updates rather than recomputing it from scratch.
A solution would clarify the expressive power of first-order dynamic programs for counting-sensitive queries.

The saved passage does not define ParityExists, initialization, or allowed modifications, so these conventions are necessary before comparing it with static first-order expressibility or ordinary parity computation.
